oneOf.description:
Specify K8s contexts to connect to.
Specifying `*` will connect to all contexts available in the K8s config file (usually `~/.kube/config`).

Default (empty or `null`) value results in using the default context from K8s's config file.

concurrency.description:
The best effort maximum number of Go routines to use.
Lower this number to reduce memory usage.

custom_resources.description:
List of Custom Resources to sync. Each custom resource is identified by its Group/Version/Kind (GVK).

Note: Core Kubernetes resources (e.g., Pods, Services) are not supported and have dedicated tables.

Spec.description: CloudQuery Kubernetes source plugin config spec.

gvk.description:
Group/Version/Kind of the custom resource in the format 'group/version/Kind'.

Examples:
- cert-manager.io/v1/Certificate
- argoproj.io/v1alpha1/Application

Note: Core resources with empty group (e.g., /v1/Pod) are not supported.

namespaces.description:
Optional list of namespaces to filter resources. If not specified, resources from all namespaces will be synced.

Examples: ["default", "production", "staging"]

CustomResourceSpec.description: Specification for a Kubernetes Custom Resource to sync.
